landmask.limitations: Permanent-water classification and systematic sampling; not current water extent or independent map accuracy validation.

scenarios.name: high_reuse_sparse_land_selection
scenarios.assumption: 25% of WorldCover-tile-covered grid centers selected; observed lower-quartile mask+processing cost; existing DEM cache.

scenarios.name: all_candidate_centers_conservative_latency
scenarios.assumption: All WorldCover-supported centers; twice slowest observed mask+processing cost for unmeasured latency/source variance.

limitations: Scenario endpoints are conditional workloads, not guaranteed global duration bounds.
Tile coverage includes water cells; true land-only cell count is not established.
DEM cold download costs are reported separately and are NOT extrapolated from this small sample.
Source overlap differences are sensitivity measurements, not independent accuracy bounds.
SRTM download time is unmeasured; imported tiles are shared by multiple windows.
Polar/dateline support and supplied USGS cells require separate operational checks.
global_decision.operational_action: Keep a regional pilot delivery until broader land-cell counts and resource measurements are available.

assumptions.cache_state: per-tile cache_hit recorded; mixed cold/warm conditions
assumptions.land_fraction: Per pilot cell; global exact land count unavailable.

limitations: No score, rank or validated negative class is produced.
A missing ocean tile is not inferred to be zero-meter terrain.
Timing values are observations, not deterministic artifacts.

operational_decision.decision_rule: Use upper conditional workload scenario at v2.3 3/8-hour boundaries; choose restricted scope conservatively.

usgs_cells.note: Kişi 3 supplies cleaned on-grid USGS cells. No source list, retrieval rank or negative labels are invented.

operational_decision.note: Pilot and scope selection are complete; unprocessed cells in the larger regional domain remain not_scanned. This is not a claim of full global or regional scan completion.
